paite: Jeriko khua Israel suante ziak in akikhak bikbek a; kuamah apawt kei ua, kuamah leng alut kei uh.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Sualna
english: Now Jericho was tightly shut up because of the children of Israel. No one went out, and no one came in.

paite: TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "En in, Jeriko leh akumpipa uh leh amihat hangsante uh na khut ah ka hon pe khinta hi.
english: Yahweh said to Joshua, “Behold, I have given Jericho into your hand, with its king and the mighty men of valor.

paite: Galdoumi tengteng in khopi kimvel in khatvei na va velsuak phot ding uh. Huchibang in ni guk sung na hih ding uh ahi.
english: All of your men of war shall march around the city, going around the city once. You shall do this six days.

paite: Siampu sagih in bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih atawi ding ua, ani sagih ni in khopi sagihvei na velsuak ding ua, siampute'n pengkul amut ding uh.
english: Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before the ark. On the seventh day, you shall march around the city seven times, and the priests shall blow the trumpets.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, belampa kii amutging uh na zak chiang un, mipi tengteng ngaihtak in kikou uhen. Huchi in khopi kulhbaang achim dia, mipi amau mazawn chiat ah apaitou ding uh," achi hi.
english: It shall be that when they make a long blast with the ram’s horn, and when you hear the sound of the trumpet, all the people shall shout with a great shout; then the city wall will fall down flat, and the people shall go up, every man straight in front of him.”

paite: Nun tapa Joshua in siampute asam a, akiang uah, "Thukhun bawm zawng unla, siampu sagih in TOUPA bawm malam ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi uhen," achi hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun called the priests, and said to them, “Take up the ark of the covenant, and let seven priests bear seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh’s ark.”

paite: Ama'n mipite kiang ah, "Pai zel unla, khopi velsuak un, mi kigalthuamte TOUPA bawm malam ah pai zel uhen,” achi hi.
english: They said to the people, “Advance! March around the city, and let the armed men pass on before Yahweh’s ark.”

paite: Hichi ahong hita a, Joshua in mipite kiang a thu agen khit in TOUPA ma a belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai zel ua, pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Kimvelna
english: It was so, that when Joshua had spoken to the people, the seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns before Yahweh advanced and blew the trumpets, and the ark of Yahweh’s covenant followed them.

paite: Mi kigalthuamte pengkul amut ua; TOUPA thukhun bawm in azui hi. 9 Mi kigalthuamte pengkul mut siampute ma ah apai ua, nungdal mite'n bawm amasuan ua, siampute'n pai kawm in pengkul amut uhi.
english: The armed men went before the priests who blew the trumpets, and the ark went after them. The trumpets sounded as they went.

paite: Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou kei unla, na aw uh leng zak hi kei hen. Kikou dia thu ka hon piak ni atun mateng na kam ua pan thu pawt kei hen. Huai hun chiang in na kikou ding uh," chi in thu apia hi.
english: Joshua commanded the people, saying, “You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard, neither shall any word proceed out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout. Then you shall shout.”

paite: TOUPA bawm khopi khatvei velh in avelsuaksak a; giahphual ah apai ua, giahphual ah agiak nawn uhi.
english: So he caused Yahweh’s ark to go around the city, circling it once. Then they came into the camp, and stayed in the camp.

paite: Joshua zingkhang in athou a, siampute'n TOUPA bawm azawng uhi.
english: Joshua rose early in the morning, and the priests took up Yahweh’s ark.

paite: TOUPA bawm ma ah belampa kii pengkul sagih tawi siampu sagihte apai ua, pengkul amut uhi. Ama uah mi kigalthuamte apai ua; nungdalte'n TOUPA bawm ahon masuan ua, siampute'n apai kawm un pengkul amut uhi.
english: The seven priests bearing the seven trumpets of rams’ horns in front of Yahweh’s ark went on continually, and blew the trumpets. The armed men went in front of them. The rear guard came after Yahweh’s ark. The trumpets sounded as they went.

paite: Ani nih ni in khopi khatvei avelsuak nawn ua, agiahphual uah akik nawn uh. Huchibang in ni guk ahih uhi.
english: The second day they marched around the city once, and returned into the camp. They did this six days.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in zingkhang, phalvak in athou ua, ahihdan ngei mah un sagihvei avelsuak ua; huai ni kia in khopi sagihvei avelsuak uhi.
english: On the seventh day, they rose early at the dawning of the day, and marched around the city in the same way seven times. On this day only they marched around the city seven times.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, asagihveina a siampute'n pengkul amuttak un Joshua in mipite kiang ah, "Kikou un: TOUPA'N khopi ahon pe khinta hi.
english: At the seventh time, when the priests blew the trumpets, Joshua said to the people, “Shout, for Yahweh has given you the city!

paite: Khopi leh asung a thil om tengteng TOUPA hamsiat ahi. Rahab kizuaknu kia, amah leh a-insung a akiang a om tengteng bel i misawlte uh ana sel ziak in hinghawi ding ahi.
english: The city shall be devoted, even it and all that is in it, to Yahweh. Only Rahab the prostitute shall live, she and all who are with her in the house, because she hid the messengers that we sent.

paite: Nou zaw hamsiat thilte a pan kihuikhe hiau un, huchi lou in zaw, hamsiat thilte la in noumau mah hamsiat in na omloh kha ding uhi. Israelte giahphual hamsiat a omsak in na buaisak kha ding uhi.
english: But as for you, only keep yourselves from what is devoted to destruction, lest when you have devoted it, you take of the devoted thing; so you would make the camp of Israel accursed and trouble it.

paite: Dangkasik, dangka-eng, dal leh sik tui-um belsuan teng ahihleh TOUPA a tuam ahi vek hi. TOUPA sum in akoih ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But all the silver, gold, and vessels of bronze and iron are holy to Yahweh. They shall come into Yahweh’s treasury.”

paite: Mipite akikou ua, siampute'n pengkul amut uhi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipite'n pengkul ging azaktak un, ngaihtak in akikou ua, kulhbaang achimta hi. Huchi in mipite amazawn chiat uah apaitou ua, khopi ah alut ua, khopi alata uhi.
heading: Jeriko Kulh Lakna
english: So the people shouted and the priests blew the trumpets. When the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted with a great shout, and the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city, every man straight in front of him, and they took the city.

paite: Khopi sung a mi tengteng, numei leh pasal, atek- akhang, bawngtal, belam leh sabiltung teng namsau in asatlum vek uhi.
english: They utterly destroyed all that was in the city, both man and woman, both young and old, and ox, sheep, and donkey, with the edge of the sword.

paite: Joshua in mi nih, gam va enkhete kiang ah, "Huai kizuaknu inn ah va lut unla, akiang a na kichiamsa bang un huai numei leh aneih teng hon pikhia un," achi hi.
heading: Rahab Inkuan Hotdamna
english: Joshua said to the two men who had spied out the land, “Go into the prostitute’s house, and bring the woman and all that she has out from there, as you swore to her.”

paite: Enkhe mi tangvalte ava lut ua, Rahab, anu leh pa, asangamte leh aneih teng ahon pikhia ua, atanau teng leng ahon pikhia ua; Israelte giahphual polam ah a-omsak uhi.
english: The young men who were spies went in, and brought out Rahab with her father, her mother, her brothers, and all that she had. They also brought out all of her relatives, and they set them outside of the camp of Israel.

paite: Khopi leh asung a thil om teng mei in ahal vek ua; dangkasik, dangka-eng, sum-eng leh sik tui-um belsuan teng kia TOUPA' inn a sumkoihna ah akoih uhi.
english: They burned the city with fire, and all that was in it. Only they put the silver, the gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron into the treasury of Yahweh’s house.

paite: Himahleh Joshua in Jeriko khua enkhe dia amisawlte ana humbit ziak in, Rahab kizuaknu leh aneih teng leh apa inkuante Joshua in ahinghawi vek a; Israelte lak ah tuni tan in ateng lai uhi.
english: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.

paite: Huai lai in Joshua in, Hiai Jeriko khopi hon lam nawn peuhmah TOUPA ma ah hamsiat in om hen. Asuangphum phummi ta masa leh akulhbaang kongpite tungkhemi ta tumpen leng hamsiat in om hen, chi in amaute ahilh chiatchiat hi.
heading: Jeriko Hamsiatna / (1 Kum 16.34)
english: Joshua commanded them with an oath at that time, saying, “Cursed is the man before Yahweh who rises up and builds this city Jericho. With the loss of his firstborn he will lay its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son he will set up its gates.”

paite: Joshua kiang ah TOUPA a-om a; gam pumpi ah amin hong thangta hi.
english: So Yahweh was with Joshua; and his fame was in all the land.
